close_reason: stoa-5yi4k.4: MtaStsEnforcer now owns a TokioResolver built once in new(); lookup_mta_sts_txt takes &TokioResolver parameter. stoa-5yi4k.6: fetch_url now uses response.chunk() loop with inline size check — body capped during streaming, not after full buffering. All 291 tests pass.
description: mta_sts_dns.rs:22 builds a new TokioResolver on every call. Building a resolver includes loading /etc/resolv.conf, creating a UDP socket, and allocating internal state. With enforce-mode policies, this runs once per unique recipient domain per delivery batch. Fix: accept a pre-built &TokioResolver from the caller (same pattern as DnsCache in session.rs), or make MtaStsEnforcer own a resolver.
title: TokioResolver rebuilt on every lookup_mta_sts_txt call — expensive
